metadata.description: OTel analytics for Claude Code, with optional hook capture. Local ClickHouse + Grafana stack with zero cloud dependencies.

plugins.name: claudalytics
plugins.description: OTel analytics for Claude Code. Captures Claude Code's own telemetry into ClickHouse, visualises via Grafana dashboards. Ships no hooks.

plugins.name: claudalytics-hook-capture
plugins.description: Optional hook capture for Claudalytics (OTel + hooks mode): the events OTel cannot give, plus a Docker stack health check at session start. Off by default; /init-claudalytics turns it on per project.
